preconditions.description: The length of the string P is between 1 and 10^6.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^6.
The indices L and R are within the bounds of the string P.

preconditions.expression: P, a, b belong to the set of lower case letters [c,h,e,f] and a != b
preconditions.description: The string P and the characters a and b are all lowercase letters from the set [c,h,e,f] and a is not equal to b.

postconditions.expression: count the number of good strings starting at a and ending at b within the range L to R
postconditions.description: For each query, count the number of good strings that start at character a and end at character b, where the starting index S_i and ending index E_i of the chosen substring satisfy L ≤ S_i < E_i ≤ R.
